versions.subject: Rule: System File Execution Location Anomaly
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    Image:
        - '*\svchost.exe'
        - '*\rundll32.exe'
        - '*\services.exe'
        - '*\powershell.exe'
        - '*\regsvr32.exe'
        - '*\spoolsv.exe'
        - '*\lsass.exe'
        - '*\conhost.exe'
        - '*\smss.exe'
        - '*\csrss.exe'
        - '*\conhost.exe'
filter:
    Image: 
        - '*\System32\*'
        - '*\SysWow64\*'
condition: selection and not filter
